_comment: The stock oracle every gauntlet stage compares choudoufu against.
.github/workflows/gauntlet.yml and .github/workflows/contribute.yml
feed these to setup-terraform and setup-opentofu; a local checkout is
NOT forced to honour them, which is why every row records the version
it was really measured against (tools/gauntlet/oracle.go's probeOracle)
and the estate page prints Stale when the two disagree. Read that
field before comparing two boards.
terraform_version was 1.16.0 and is 1.16.1 because 1.16.0 carries a
graph regression that makes the ORACLE itself nondeterministic:
hashicorp/terraform#39089, a spurious `Error: Cycle` on an acyclic
configuration, and hashicorp/terraform#39076, a planned
destroy-then-create applied create-before-destroy with the destroy
silently dropped. Both land at 038c6f72 (PR #38840, 1.16.0-alpha),
both are fixed by PR #39091 in 1.16.1, and 1.15.9 is the last good
release before them. Measured on corpus-rds-complete-postgres's own
day2_replace stock oracle plan, 20 runs each against one frozen
cold_deploy state on the pinned emulator: 1.16.0 gave 11 clean plans
and 9 cycles, 1.16.1 gave 20 clean plans and 0 cycles. See #947.
A human maintains this file deliberately: hand-edit, then run
`just oracle-bump` for the movement report before landing it.
aws_provider_version (#1034) is a THIRD, independent fact this file
pins for the same reason as the two above: a plain `terraform init`
resolves a corpus module's bare `hashicorp/aws` requirement against
registry.terraform.io's newest matching release, while choudoufu's own
init resolves the identical bare source against registry.opentofu.org,
an independent mirror. On 2026-09-09 hashicorp/aws 6.64.0 published to
the former hours before the latter mirrored it, and the two crossing
halves of five estates read two different provider versions off the
same lock file. live/e2e/lib/gauntlet.sh's gauntlet_pin_aws_provider
reads this field and rewrites every corpus module copy's
required_providers block to an exact `= <this>` before either binary
ever runs `init`, so which registry answered stops mattering. Verified
on both registries before every bump - see live/e2e/lib/gauntlet.sh's
own comment for the check command. This is NOT
internal/live/pins.AWSProviderVersion: that constant pins the release
tools/survey-gen and tools/corpus-gen analyze provider SCHEMAS against
(bumping it regenerates live/survey-full.json and
live/corpus-refusals.json - a deliberate, separate event per that
package's own doc comment); this field pins the release the gauntlet's
own corpus estates actually DEPLOY against emulated AWS.
